title: the life-cycle walk on a phone, 390 px (lane H, 2026-11-17)

findings.claim: On a phone (390 px) the top bar's links, the language box and Sign out are behind "☰ Menu", whose visible label is hidden from assistive technology; the accessible control is a hidden check box named "Menu"
On a phone the job page's (/pilot/jobs/{job}) thread table is 720 to 915 px wide, the SCREEN job's rows 829 to 937 px and a FEAS job's funnel 417 px; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame
On a phone, in ja only, the S20 approval table (/pilot/jobs/{job}/approval) is 463 to 485 px wide; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame
On a phone the delegation log (/studies/{rs}/team) is 792 to 932 px wide; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame

On a phone the feasibility funnel (/studies/{rs}/feasibility) is 488 to 506 px wide, the reports list 448 to 518 px and, in ja, the barriers table 400 px; the tables scroll sideways inside their own frames
On a phone, in zh-TW and ja, the feasibility report's five step links are 40 and 31 px wide by 44 px, under the 44 px the card asks of phone controls
On a phone the administrator's home tabs and links ("Jobs", "Services and models", "Sources and licences", "Open", "Mail notices"; seven in all) are 20 px high, under the spec's 24 x 24 px targets
On a phone the weekly page's worklist (/studies/{rs}/week) is a table 437 to 482 px wide, where the spec expects a card list; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame
On a phone the candidate list (/studies/{rs}/candidates) is 643 to 724 px wide; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame

On a phone the coordinator's line on the weekly page ("The investigator decides here; you get a task when they mark Approach…") is only in the patient sheet, shown after a row is tapped; the desktop shows it beside the list
On a phone, with a patient's sheet open on the weekly page, the sheet's bar ("← Back to the list") covers "☰ Menu": the coordinator taps Back first to reach the menu and My studies
On a phone the study's state history (/studies/{rs}/state) is 395 to 445 px wide; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame
On a phone the opt-out register's list (/site/opt-outs) is 467 to 565 px wide; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame
On a phone the audit trail's table (/audit) is 1,355 to 1,383 px wide, a row's time on the left and its detail on the right; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame
On a phone the audit filter's "Clear" link (/audit) is 32 to 40 by 24 px, under the 44 px the card asks of phone controls
On a phone the Participants list (/studies/{rs}/subjects) is a table 413 to 423 px wide (en, ja), seen since train 79; the table scrolls sideways inside its own frame
